description: Biomedical Informatics students at Nile University tackling the astronaut health monitoring challenge. ASTRA compares each astronaut to their own baseline (HR, HRV, sleep, SpO2, activity), detects slow changes early, and tells them what changed, what to do, and when to call the flight surgeon. We bring health data, Python, explainable AI and backend skills. Looking for: Flutter/web frontend, UI/UX (Figma), data visualization, or space medicine/pitching experience.
